plan: To maximize profit, I aim to bid slightly above the average expected bid of the other rational bidders. Given my value of $42, I expect others to bid around their values, averaging $24.5. I will bid $35 to balance winning likelihood and profit margin, ensuring I pay below my value if I win. This strategy maximizes expected profit by winning with a reasonable margin over others' bids while minimizing the cost.

Given my private value of $6, I should bid conservatively to maximize profit. Rational opponents likely bid close to their values. To win, I should bid slightly above half my value, around $3, as this minimizes potential loss if I win, paying the third-highest bid. If I lose, I incur no cost. This strategy balances winning potential with risk management.

Since this is the only round, I'll focus on maximizing immediate profit. My value is $16. To win, I must bid higher than others but not exceed my value. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their values, so I'll bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win. A bid of $15.5 should be competitive, allowing a potential profit if I win and pay a lower third-highest bid.
